title: Target marginals reconstructed from a median with IQR or range
question: When a target publication reports a skewed covariate as a median with IQR or range, how much error does reconstructing its marginal put into a target-standardized contrast, and is that error a function of the reconstructed mean alone?
design: Known conditional model integrated over reconstructed target marginals, 72 cells crossing link, skewness, reported summary, target size and modification strength; normal (Wan et al.) and quantile-matched lognormal reconstructions against the sample floor. 1000 replicates per cell.
